acceptance.failure: If preset creation remains unconfirmed after the bounded read-only reconciliation horizon, issue no PTZ movement. If a later visual gate fails after creation, preserve the preset privately and stop without an automatic preset recall.
acceptance.success: The preset is confirmed without repeating SetPreset, and the direct return reaches a fresh quiet frame with overlap at least 0.85 and canonical-controller displacement at most 3 px.

hypothesis: A camera can publish a newly created preset after the ambiguous SetPreset response. Bounded catalog reads can confirm that outcome without repeating the mutation; then two short visual responses gate any longer correction pulse.

recovery.temporary_preset: created before outbound; retained privately unless direct visual return is strict

outcome: The bounded read-only reconciliation did not find a new preset because the camera advertises a maximum of eight presets and the inventory already contains eight. No physical command was issued and no existing preset was removed.
